perks-quantgpt.title: What QuantGPT includes
perks-quantgpt.body: Backtests on our data, 200 a day, and Connect your AI: MCP, the open standard Claude and ChatGPT use to reach outside tools, 500 calls a day on 3 keys. Plus Ask AI, the library, your journal and the monitor.

perks-pro.title: What QuantGPT Pro adds
perks-pro.body: Everything in QuantGPT, plus 1,500 AI calls a day on 5 keys, prediction markets, the QuantGPT Pro rooms on the forum, browsing the strategy exchange, the full portfolio review and the Excel model.

trial-line.title: The 3 day trial
trial-line.body: QuantGPT and QuantGPT Pro start with 3 days free, card up front, on the plan's full daily limits. Cancel within the 3 days and you pay nothing.
